_comment: Buy-path Sanity reads that must bypass the 60 s data cache (sanityFetch live: true). Consumed by scripts/checks/buy-path-live-reads.mts (rule 1 and 2) and by checks/mutate_live_reads.py (mutations). A sanityFetch call passes when its options object has a `live` property whose value is the literal `true` or the identifier `live` (the loadTicketCardViewModels parameter). A call that omits `live`, passes `live: false`, or spreads an unknown object FAILS unless listed in `allow_not_live`.

allow_not_live.reason: page copy strings (sold-out and sales-closed messages); accepted 60 s staleness per docs/sanity-request-volume.md

capacity-pool sibling membership and headcountPerUnit for the sold-out display only; shared with the hub through loadTicketCardViewModels, so making it live would raise hub Sanity volume; checkout re-reads live. Open question for the team lead, see spec.md finding 2

_minimum_sites_note: Guards against a checker that silently finds zero calls (renamed import, wrapper) and so passes vacuously. A file with fewer matched calls than listed fails with setup error exit 2.

mutations._note: layout.tsx has no direct sanityFetch today; M9 proves a NEW non-live sanityFetch added to a covered file is caught
